description: Fetch one catalog category by id: name, slug, parent, description, image, translations, the linked marketplace category ids (marketplaceCategories: Prom, Rozetka, OLX, Amazon, Google Merchant, each { id, label } or null), its direct subcategories (children), and productCount and subcategoryCount. Read-only. Use list_categories first to find the id, and call this before delete_category to see what a deletion would affect.

id.description: The category id returned by list_categories.

name: get_category
title: Get category
